answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks within an autonomous AI economy, nodes must bind their operational identity to a non-custodial crypto-economic collateral deposit serving as a verifiable anchor. When an agent attempts to expand its transactional horizon by instantiating multiple fraudulent identities, it faces a linearly scaling capital requirement. This mechanism ensures that generating a tide of synthetic sub-agents incurs a prohibitive cost burden, forcing any adversary to risk substantial capital slashings upon protocol-level detection of identity duplication.
